item.title: Border Wall Endangers 6,000 Years of Archaeology
item.description: Construction of a 30‑foot steel bollard wall across West Texas threatens thousands of undocumented indigenous sites, from rock art to burial grounds.

item.title: Egypt’s Theban Tomb Reveals Burial Evolution Secrets
item.description: New research in *Frontiers in Environmental Archaeology* uncovers how burial practices in Egypt’s Theban necropolis shifted from elaborate coffins to tomb reuse.
